2608.06057.title: When History Lies: Evaluating and Improving Tool Use under Misleading Multi-Turn Histories
2608.06057.paper_summary: Tool-calling agents infer task state from accumulated dialogue and tool traces. In persistent interactions, however, historical traces may remain structurally valid and semantically plausible after they cease to be authoritative for the current request. We show that such history can hijack a policy the model already possesses: on Qwen3-1.7B, pollution flips 32.1% of decisions that are correct under the original trajectory and frequently induces reuse of corrupted entities or interface conventions. We introduce bench, a paired benchmark with synchronized Original, Polluted, and Oracle State views that preserve the system policy, current tools, latest request, and gold next action. Eleven gold-preserving interventions isolate failures in decision state, entity binding, and interface execution across complete calls and non-call decisions. We further propose ours, which transfers an Oracle-conditioned teacher policy to a student observing only polluted history through soft supervision on student-generated prefixes. On Qwen3-1.7B, ours achieves 87.0% Balanced Tool-Use Accuracy, outperforming Gold-SFT (66.3%), Oracle sequence distillation (82.3%), and off-policy token distillation (85.0%). The method scales consistently: an 8B teacher raises the same compact 1.7B student to 91.9%, while an 8B student reaches 93.0%. The resulting policies further transfer to clean histories, unseen functions, independently regenerated evaluation contexts, external tool-use benchmarks, and noisy multi-hop question answering. These results establish history reliability as a distinct tool-use bottleneck and demonstrate reliable-state policy transfer as an effective and scalable solution.
2608.06057.paper_summary_zh: 工具呼叫代理從累積的對話和工具痕跡中推斷任務狀態。 然而，在持續的互動中，歷史痕跡在不再對當前請求具有權威性後，可能仍然在結構上有效且語義上合理。 我們展示了這樣的歷史如何劫持模型已擁有的策略：在 Qwen3-1.7B 上，污染翻轉了 32.1% 在原始軌跡下正確的決策，並且經常誘導重用被損壞的實體或介面約定。 我們引入了 bench，一個配對基準，具有同步的原始、污染和 Oracle 狀態視圖，保留系統策略、當前工具、最新請求和金標下一步行動。 十一個保留金標的干預措施隔離了決策狀態、實體綁定和介面執行中的失敗，涵蓋了完整的呼叫和非呼叫決策。 我們進一步提出 ours，這是一種將 Oracle 條件教師策略轉移到僅觀察污染歷史的學生的方式，通過對學生生成的前綴進行軟監督。 在 Qwen3-1.7B 上，ours 實現了 87.0% 的平衡工具使用準確率，超越了 Gold-SFT（66.3%）、Oracle 序列蒸餾（82.3%）和離策略標記蒸餾（85.0%）。 該方法具有一致的擴展性：一個 8B 教師將同樣的緊湊 1.7B 學生提升到 91.9%，而一個 8B 學生達到 93.0%。 生成的策略進一步轉移到乾淨的歷史、未見的功能、獨立再生的評估上下文、外部工具使用基準和嘈雜的多跳問題回答。 這些結果確立了歷史可靠性作為一個獨特的工具使用瓶頸，並展示了可靠狀態策略轉移作為一種有效且可擴展的解決方案。
